checks.sentence: The main house that governs marriage is less supported than most of the others. [vote:marriage.house]

propositions.text: There is one main house that governs marriage (the 7th house).
propositions.evidence: The finding's glossary defines the 7th house as 'marriage, partners, partnerships and travel', and its area_houses entries name the 7th (by lagna, Moon and Sun) a marriage house; the Bhavat Bhavam entry calls the 1st a 'second seat' of the 7th's matters, marking the 7th itself as the primary one.

propositions.text: The other houses taken up are also marriage houses (the 2nd, 11th, 8th, and the 1st as the 7th's Bhavat Bhavam, each from lagna, Moon and Sun).
propositions.evidence: area_houses lists all of these with the words 'a marriage house' (the 1st as 'the 7th's Bhavat Bhavam').

propositions.text: The main marriage house is less supported (weaker) than most of those other houses.
